description.content: Returns all domain pattern definitions for the calling client. Domain patterns define which URL patterns the Extole platform recognises as belonging to this client — they control campaign-tracking domain matching, shareable link generation, and zone-rendering domain allow-listing. Each entry includes its `pattern`, `type` (`GLOB`, `DOMAIN`, or `SUB_DOMAIN`), and the optional `client_domain_id` that links it to a specific program domain configuration.
